from_contact_attribute.description: Connect attribute the contact flow passes in, e.g. '$.CustomerEndpoint.Address'
from_contact_attribute.title: From Contact Attribute

conversation_style.description: One of ('generative', 'scripted'). 'generative' (default): each operation is run by a generative_journey that talks freely, with deterministic islands only where they are needed — mandatory wording, strict-format identifiers, money/eligibility/compliance/identity decisions, backend calls, hand-off. 'scripted': every step is a fixed node; only when the customer explicitly asks for a scenario-driven agent.
conversation_style.title: Conversation Style

default_flows.description: role → flow_id; derived from system flows when empty
default_flows.title: Default Flows

timezone.description: IANA time zone the business runs on ('Asia/Seoul', 'America/Chicago'). Journeys count 'today' and 'tomorrow' in it — the ACXD runtime's own clock runs on America/New_York. Empty: derived from the primary locale (ko → Asia/Seoul, ja → Asia/Tokyo); any other language needs it recorded.
timezone.title: Timezone

project_name.description: ACXD only: ASCII kebab-case project name ('selc-voice'). Workspace-level resources (the backend-key secret, guardrails) are named after it, the way InfrastructureSpec.project_name names them in the other targets.
project_name.title: Project Name

backend_base_url.description: ACXD only: https base URL of the customer's existing API. The Data Requests call {WEBHOOK_URL}<operation path>; this is the default for WEBHOOK_URL at deploy time. Empty = supplied when deploying.
backend_base_url.title: Backend Base Url

backend_auth_header.description: ACXD only: the header the customer's API reads its credential from ('x-api-key', 'Authorization', …). The value is an ACXD Secret set at deploy time, never stored. '' = the API takes no credential header; None = not decided yet.
backend_auth_header.title: Backend Auth Header
